messages:
Marcos: Heads up — tenant 42 reported a sudden spike in streaming reconnects overnight. Console shows ~4x bump around 03:12 UTC. Looks correlated with aggregator sampling change?
Priya: ouch. can you paste the console link and a couple logs? https://console.redwood/tenants/42/streams
Marcos: logs pasted below:
```text
[2026-02-18T03:12:05Z] route=us-east-1 tenant=42 conn=abc123 last_ping=35s event=heartbeat_miss
[2026-02-18T03:12:06Z] route=us-east-1 tenant=42 conn=abc123 sse: client disconnected (code=1006)
[2026-02-18T03:12:07Z] proxy: sampled_event=heartbeat route=us-east-1 sample_rate=1/60
```
Sam: suspect: proxy sampler aggregates heartbeat/pingback events every 60s, but our client heartbeat is 15s. Short lived dropouts get under-sampled => reconnects not visible in dashboard and billing attribution gets messy.
Janet: confirm — console only shows sampled telemetry now for performance reasons. That means short reconnect bursts are invisible unless they cross the sampling boundary. UX problem.
Marcos: mitigation idea: temporarily unsample tenant 42, and enable sticky routing to Dedicated pool for them to avoid route flips while we triage. Also increase `resume_window_ms` for their route to 90_000 to reduce false double-charges.
Priya: agree on mitigation. Can we do a quick feature-flagged rollout? `streaming_unified_sampling=false` for tenant 42 for 1 hour.
Rachel: (ops-bot) scheduled action: canary toggle allowed. Target tenant=42 unsample enabled in 12m. ETA 15m. (reaction :white_check_mark:)
Sam: quick patch suggestion for aggregator to avoid dropping `pingback` events:
```js
// aggregator telemetry shim
if (event.type === 'pingback' || event.type === 'resume') {
  emitTelemetry(event, { sample_rate: 1 }); // force full sampling for these event types
} else {
  emitTelemetry(event);
}
```
Marcos: console-side ask: we need an unsampled per-route `reconnect_count` metric surfaced in Billing > Streaming so support can triage cost spikes without toggling sampling every time.
Janet: we'll need to dedupe resume vs fresh connections in the billing calc. Plan: tag resume attempts with `resume_id` on the ingress and join later during billing aggregation to avoid double-counting.
Priya: long-term: add a `stream_telemetry_v2` flag that distinguishes `probe_type` (heartbeat/pingback/proxy-ping). Canary 5% eng-sandbox -> 25% -> full. Also add a dashboard card showing "estimated reconnect cost" and sampling bias slider.
Marcos: can we also log the proxied event IDs in the telemetry to help root-cause on route-swap vs network blip? just one extra header `X-Proxy-Event-Id` would help.
Sam: yup small change in proxy. Will open PR and include tests to assert `pingback` emitted with sample_rate=1. I'll own sticky-route toggle too.
Janet: I'll scope the console card. Need a backend join on `resume_id` to avoid double billing. Creating ticket ENG-STREAM-934.
Priya: action items (quick):
  1) Priya - unsample tenant 42 for 1h (feature toggle)
  2) Sam - sticky route toggle + aggregator patch for pingback sampling
  3) Marcos - telemetry PR for `probe_type` and `X-Proxy-Event-Id`
  4) Janet - console card + billing dedupe ticket
I'll open PRs/tickets and link here.
Marcos: thanks all. If you see more examples paste logs here. Also ping @oncall if we see customer-impacting billing spikes. :eyes:
ops-bot: reminder: unsample toggle has been scheduled by Rachel at 03:27 UTC (automatic rollback at 04:27 UTC)
